name: ChannelSale – Sync WooCommerce Amazon, Walmart, Ebay, Wayfair and more
author: ChannelSale

sections.description:
ChannelSale – Multi-Marketplace Automation for WooCommerce

Connect your WooCommerce store to Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Wayfair, Etsy, Newegg, Best Buy, Bed Bath & Beyond, Facebook, Instagram, Mercado Libre, Fruugo, Google Shopping, TikTok Shop, and 200+ additional marketplaces and sales channels from one centralized platform.

ChannelSale helps growing businesses simplify multi-channel selling by automating product listings, inventory synchronization, pricing updates, order management, and shipment tracking—reducing manual work, helping prevent overselling, and keeping every sales channel synchronized in near real time.

Start risk-free with our FREE Plan for Inventory & Order Sync and experience ChannelSale before upgrading.

Why Choose ChannelSale?

Managing multiple marketplaces shouldn’t require managing multiple systems.

ChannelSale provides one centralized solution to help you:
* Create and manage product listings across multiple marketplaces
* Synchronize inventory in near real time
* Automatically import marketplace orders into WooCommerce
* Send shipment tracking updates back to marketplaces
* Reduce manual tasks and operational errors
* Help prevent overselling
* Improve marketplace efficiency and scalability
* Scale your marketplace business more efficiently

Every plan includes FREE fully managed onboarding, implementation, and setup by our marketplace specialists, helping you get started quickly and confidently.

Grow Marketplace Sales with Expert Listing Optimization

Need help expanding your marketplace presence?

Our marketplace specialists use industry best practices to create and optimize product listings, helping improve:
* Product visibility
* Marketplace search rankings
* Conversion rates
* Marketplace performance
* Long-term sales growth

Supported Integrations

Connect WooCommerce with leading marketplaces and sales channels, including:

Amazon ★ eBay ★ Walmart ★ Google Shopping ★ Facebook ★ Instagram ★ TikTok ★ Etsy ★ Wayfair ★ Bed Bath & Beyond ★ BestBuy ★ Newegg ★ Temu ★ Wish.com ★ Sears ★ Mercado Libre ★ Fruugo ★ Shopping.com ★ Pricegrabber ★ and many more

Key Features

✓ Connect WooCommerce with 200+ marketplaces through one integration
✓ Synchronize:
* Product listings
* Inventory
* Pricing
* Orders
* Shipment tracking
✓ Near real-time updates
✓ Support for:
* Individual listings
* Variable products
* Bundles
* Kits
* Parent-child variations
✓ Marketplace-specific pricing rules and automated repricing support
✓ Advanced business rules for product data optimization
✓ Custom attributes for marketplace requirements
✓ Multi-warehouse and multi-currency support
✓ Integrations with shipping, fulfilment, inventory, and accounting systems
✓ Reporting and marketplace management tools

Why Businesses Choose ChannelSale

  • Trusted by online retailers since 2007
  • Millions of product listings synchronized across multiple sales channels
  • FREE managed onboarding and implementation
  • No setup fees for supported integrations
  • No sales commissions
  • Flexible month-to-month pricing
  • Dedicated marketplace specialists
  • Ongoing product enhancements and new marketplace integrations
  • Full ownership of your business data

Account Setup and Pricing

A ChannelSale account is required to activate the plugin. Once we confirm your requirements match the plugin features and our services, our specialists will guide you through account creation and provide FREE managed onboarding to help you get up and running quickly.

  • FREE Plan – Inventory & Order Sync for up to 500 marketplace products and 15 orders per month, including managed setup and onboarding.
  • Flexible paid plans starting from $19/month, designed to scale with your business.
  • No long-term contracts – flexible month-to-month subscriptions.
  • Flat-fee pricing with zero commission on your sales.
  • View all plans and pricing here, link will redirect to ChannelSale website pricing page.

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 4.7 or greater
  • WooCommerce 2.6.0 or greater
  • PHP version 5.2 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater

Support

Our experienced marketplace specialists are available to help with setup, onboarding, training, and ongoing support.

sections.installation:
Getting started is quick and easy.

  1. Email support@channelsale.com to request your FREE managed setup.
  2. Our specialists will review your requirements to ensure ChannelSale is the right fit for your business.
  3. Once confirmed, we’ll send you an account activation link and guide you through the complete setup process—at no cost for the Free Plan.

Plugin Installation

  • Install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugins page by selecting Add New and uploading the ChannelSale ZIP file, or
  • Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  • Activate the ChannelSale plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.

Our team is available to assist with installation, onboarding, and configuration to help you get up and running quickly.

Website: www.channelsale.com
sections.faq:
Does the plugin support creating product listings on Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Wayfair and other marketplaces?

Yes. ChannelSale creates new product listings, updates existing listings, and supports both simple and variation products across supported marketplaces.

Does the plugin synchronize orders and shipment tracking with WooCommerce?

Yes. ChannelSale automatically imports orders from connected marketplaces into WooCommerce and synchronizes shipment tracking updates back to the marketplaces after fulfilment.

Which marketplaces are supported?

ChannelSale integrates with Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Google Shopping, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok Shop, Etsy, Wayfair, Best Buy, Newegg, Bed Bath & Beyond, Temu, Mercado Libre, Fruugo, OnBuy, Shopping.com, PriceGrabber, and 200+ additional marketplaces and sales channels.

Is a live demo available?

Yes. Contact us at email info@channelsale.com to schedule a personalized live demonstration with one of our marketplace specialists.

What does the FREE Plan include?

The FREE Plan includes Inventory and Order Sync for up to 500 marketplace products and 15 orders per month, along with FREE managed setup and onboarding.

What does the FREE Trial include?

The FREE Trial includes everything in the FREE Plan, plus sample product listings created and published on your choice of any 1 marketplace Amazon, eBay, or Walmart, allowing you to experience ChannelSale before upgrading.

Where can I view pricing?

View our pricing plans here, link will redirect to ChannelSale website pricing page.

How do I install and activate the plugin?

Installing the plugin is simple. To activate it, you’ll need a ChannelSale account.
Contact us at email info@channelsale.com or visit here
Our team will review your requirements, provide a FREE managed setup, and guide you through account activation and onboarding.

Need additional help?

Please contact us via email info@channelsale.com, Our support team is happy to assist.
Email: info@channelsale.com or here.
